name: Citizenship by Registration -- Marriage to a Bangladeshi Citizen

requirements.blocker_text: Applicant must be a woman married to a Bangladeshi citizen -- the Citizenship Act, 1951's registration-by-marriage provision as sourced in this build applies to women; no equivalent provision for a man married to a Bangladeshi woman was located.
Obtaining a certificate of domicile and taking the oath of allegiance in the form set out in the Act's Schedule.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT (European University Institute) -- Bangladesh Citizenship Act, 1951 (hosted verbatim text): women married to citizens may apply for registration upon obtaining a certificate of domicile and taking the oath of allegiance set out in the Act's Schedule; a separate provision automatically extends citizenship to a woman who was a British subject by marriage before 1 January 1949

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Bangladesh). STATUS: DRAFT -- tier-2 only (GLOBALCIT/EUI hosting of the verbatim Act text, consistent with this dataset's established convention for academic hosting of primary legal text); no tier-1 Bangladeshi-government copy of this specific provision was located in this build. GENDERED FINDING, CONSISTENT WITH A PATTERN SEEN REPEATEDLY IN THIS DATASET (Qatar, Bahrain, Nigeria): the sourced text frames this registration route around women married to (male) citizens -- no equivalent registration-by-marriage provision for a man married to a Bangladeshi woman was found in the source material retrieved. This may reflect an incomplete extraction of the Act's full text rather than a confirmed absence of a symmetric provision -- flagged as an open verification item rather than asserted as a confirmed gender-restriction, given the source excerpt available in this build was partial. No residence-duration figure was found for this route; citizenship_after_months set to 0 rather than an invented figure. dual_citizenship_allowed FALSE per the Citizenship Act 1951's general prohibition, same as bd_citizenship_naturalisation.json.
